for file in "${files[@]}"; do
  # Find lines with .GetUser( call
  grep -n "\.GetUser(" "$file" | while IFS=: read -r line_num rest; do

    func_name=$(awk -v start=$line_num 'NR <= start && /^func / {f=$0} NR == start {print f; exit}' "$file")
